entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I then look for the 9:30 candle, which is the market open in New York
entry_sequence.action: Use the 9:30 New York 15-minute candle as the opening range reference candle.
entry_sequence.rationale: This candle defines the session's initial range.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: Once I've got that, I'm going to mark out the high and the low.
entry_sequence.action: Mark the high and low of the 9:30 15-minute candle to define the opening range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The high and low become the breakout boundaries.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I prefer to wait for the candle to actually break through and then close above
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a 15-minute candle to break above the opening range and close above it.
entry_sequence.rationale: The close outside the range is the breakout confirmation.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I then enter at the open of the next one.
entry_sequence.action: Enter long at the open of the next candle after the breakout close.
entry_sequence.rationale: The next candle open is the actual execution point.

stop.transcript_quote: the stop loss goes at the bottom of the range
stop.rationale: He says the stop loss goes at the bottom of the range.

targets.transcript_quote: I target 1.5 to one reward to risk.
targets.rationale: He targets 1.5 to one reward to risk.

confluences.transcript_quote: I don't trade after the 12:00 candle
confluences.name: no_entries_after_1200_candle
confluences.description: He does not trade after the 12:00 candle.

confluences.transcript_quote: I also don't trade ranges that are either too small or too big based on the recent ATR
confluences.name: opening_range_size_filtered_by_atr
confluences.description: He avoids opening ranges that are too small or too big based on the recent ATR.

confluences.transcript_quote: I made sure that this was greater than at least 1 times ATR to be considered a suitable breakout.
confluences.name: breakout_must_exceed_1_atr
confluences.description: He requires the breakout height to be greater than at least 1 times ATR to count as a suitable breakout.
